question: Which of the following occupies less memory when saving an MS-Word file?
solution:
The correct answer is __**docx**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **docx** files typically occupy less memory compared to other MS-Word file formats.
 
• The **docx** format is a compressed file format, which makes it more storage-efficient.
 
• Introduced in Microsoft Word 2007, **docx** is an XML-based file format that reduces file size and improves data recovery options.
 
• In contrast, **doc** files, which were used in versions of Microsoft Word prior to 2007, are generally larger because they are not compressed.
 
• The **docm** format is similar to **docx** but includes macros, which can increase the file size.
 
• The **docc** format is not a standard MS-Word file format.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using the **docx** format can improve file-sharing and storage efficiency.
 
• It also supports a variety of advanced features such as improved graphics and better integration with other Microsoft Office applications.
 
• Due to its widespread adoption, **docx** files are highly compatible with various word processing software.
 
• Converting older **doc** files to **docx** can help in saving storage space.
